selected.where: text.replace("___", "-") replaces only fixed triple underscores, not arbitrary runs of 3+ spaces
selected.how: The spec requires replacing any run of >2 spaces with a single hyphen; fixed literal replacement leaves extra underscores for runs longer than 3.
selected.what: Input "a     b" (5 spaces) yields "a__-b" instead of "a-b"; extra underscores remain for runs exceeding the fixed literal length.
